decisions.rationale: The span names a specific complement component deficiency, i.e. C6 deficiency, which is one defined disease rather than a family of diseases. It is comparable to the 'C7 deficiency' example, which is annotated as a Specific Disease. The word 'Human' is outside the span and is not annotated.
'Meningococcal meningitis' names one specific infectious disease (meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis) with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.
'Haemostasis abnormality' is a very general term, similar to 'abnormalities', and does not refer to a specific disease. Such general terms are excluded.
'Complete C6 deficiency' refers to one specific form of complement C6 deficiency. The qualifier 'complete' identifies a particular disease form, so the whole span is the minimum necessary mention.
